title: Banners in the ash — a warlord's camp
description: Ashford colours on a palisade of charred stakes. Raiders drill in the yard; a sergeant bellows counts. This is not a gang. This is an army's forward camp, and the road runs past its gate.

choices.text: Slip past under cover of the drill.

onPass.narration: Between one count and the next you are past the gate and into the ash-fog. Nobody so much as turns.

onFail.narration: A sentry on the palisade sees something move where nothing should. The drill stops. The gate opens.

choices.text: Pay the sergeant to look elsewhere.

onPass.narration: Sixty in Ashford silver and the sergeant discovers a sudden interest in the far side of the yard.

onFail.narration: You count it out and come up short. The sergeant counts it too.

choices.text: Hit the camp before it hits you.

onPass.narration: You take the gate at a run. The drill becomes a battle line faster than you would like.
